items.q: Which caption is printed beneath the first pair of angiograms at the top of this page?
opts: Stents in renal artery bifurcation stenosis
items.exp: The first two images are captioned 'Stents in renal artery bifurcation stenosis'; the round pre-op/post-op pair carries 'Severe stenosis' and 'Good flow', and the beaded angiogram below belongs to fibromuscular dysplasia. (Book p752)

items.q: The two round fluoroscopy images are headed 'Pre-op' and 'Post-op' and captioned 'Severe stenosis' and 'Good flow' respectively.
opts: True — the pair documents the angiographic result before and after intervention
False — both images are labelled pre-operative
False — the captions read 'mild stenosis' and 'no flow'
True — and the same figure is captioned 'string of beads'
items.exp: The heading row prints Pre-op over the first image and Post-op over the second, with the captions 'Severe stenosis' and 'Good flow' under them. (Book p752)

items.q: Along with peak systolic velocity above 180 cm/s and RAR above 3.5, the colour doppler criteria accept a change in resistivity index greater than:
items.exp: The RI < 0.8 arm reads: Peak systolic velocity > 180 cm/s OR RAR > 3.5 OR ΔRI > 0.05, all routing to CT/MR renal angiography. (Book p752)

items.q: Fill up: When the colour doppler study is labelled 'Investigation inconclusive', the flowchart sends the patient for ______.
items.exp: Both the RI ≥ 0.8 side path 'Investigation inconclusive' and the RI < 0.8 positive-criteria path converge on CT/MR renal angiography, marked (IOC). (Book p752)

items.q: Fill up: Under 'Incident', fibromuscular dysplasia is stated to be most common in ______.
items.exp: The FMD block reads: Non atherosclerotic/non inflammatory Arteriopathy; Incident: m/c in young girls; pathology — middle to distal renal artery, medial fibroplasia in tunica media; 25% B/L renal artery and 25% cerebral vessels; Treatment: PTRA (good prognosis). (Book p752)
